query:
-- Cobranças de reparo do Luciano em inspection_charges
SELECT ic.id, ic.charge_type, ic.amount, ic.due_date, ic.payment_status, ic.client_email, ic.asaas_charge_id
FROM inspection_charges ic
LEFT JOIN allowed_clients ac ON ac.email = ic.client_email
WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Luciano%'
ORDER BY ic.due_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
